_source: Reverse probe built from the facts of CBP ruling N366163 (2026-11-05): Champ air purifier; CBP held Vietnam. Same-day ruling N366164 on the same product with the parts listed in actual_change from China: CBP still held Vietnam. Post-cutoff control pair (D170). Filters are put in the motor-fan group (the air path); plant capabilities for China are an assumption.
